steps.note: Open the single-stage create screen specified by the case.
Configure the tenant so vendors cannot be added during event creation.
Enable the setting whose effect on the create screen is being explored.
Set the event type to RFQ and configure the single-stage event.
A title is required for a valid create-screen setup.
Choose the available RFQ pricing template before adding the product.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Capture the configured screen to document what the mandatory-T&C setting changes.
Open the Terms and Conditions control to inspect the setting's visible effect.
Assert that inspecting the Terms and Conditions control did not produce an application error or crash.
